title: Russian Fricatives
why_promising: Primary controlled Russian speech from 59 speakers across 77 recording sessions and 198 sentences, yielding 22,561 target-fricative tokens. MAUS-generated TextGrids were manually inspected and corrected for target-fricative boundaries in Praat. Public metadata documents sentence/interval identifiers, SAMPA and IPA labels, preceding/following sounds, word position, voicing, palatalization, and extracted target-fricative WAVs, making this a high-value manually verified production source.
open_question: Dataset files require SWISSUbase authenticated/restricted-access contract. When access is available, ingest only the manually inspected/corrected target-fricative layer plus source-faithful metadata; do not treat unrelated automatically segmented intervals as human-verified. Preserve the closed-license lineage and do not redistribute restricted audio/TextGrids.
